text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
It's payback time in the Selection Race!
Uoooooooooooh~~~!

Ever since that day when she had that dreamy,
determined look on her face,
Shinko Windy threw herself wholeheartedly
into training.

Her immediate target was set firmly on
winning the upcoming Selection Race.

Since I was the one who fired her up,
I was going to give her every bit of support
I could. That meant――

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Phew~! That was a solid run!
My throat's completely parched now. ――Hm?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
What's with this drink? \"For Windy-san\"?
Who left it?
……Well, who cares, down the hatch!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, it's pouring cats and dogs……!
Can't even see two feet ahead…… and right
when I was totally set on training too.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Wonder if the gym's open?
Though with this weather……

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
…………Hm? \"Reserved for Shinko Windy\"?
……Why?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Whatever, works for me!
I'm tearing up the gym today!

And so the days went by,
until…… the day of the Selection Race
arrived.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Pheeew~~~……!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hm…… huh? That girl with the striped ribbon,
pretty sure she's been on a crazy winning
streak lately……

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Nuooo-!

In her last mock race,
Shinko Windy got overwhelmed by her
surroundings and ended up biting the dust.

That defeat had evidently shaken her
confidence,
causing her focus to waver once again under
pressure.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
H-…… Hmph, you don't gotta tell me twice!
Today, Windy-chan is taking the crown!

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
The Selection Race, 1600 meters on Dirt,
under heavy rain conditions! And now,
they're off!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah, haah, haah!

Her positioning was solid.
Maintaining her composure,
she held her ground as the race developed.
And then……

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
They've rounded the fourth corner and hit
the home straight! A fierce fight for the lead!
Shinko Windy is surging forward!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
(At this rate, I can blow past them!
I'm taking the front in one shot!)

The fire in Shinko Windy's eyes was
unmistakable.
She poured every ounce of power into her
stride, and right then――

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Hang in there,
hold that lead all the way to the line!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
They're right on your tail……!
Go, push through-!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: (……No, no, no, stay focused!)

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
(……They told me straight up! That I'm talented,
super cool,
a national treasure!
They're counting on my future!)

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
(They believe I can win…… and right now,
they're cheering for ME……!)

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
No way I'm losing…… I'm gonna win, win,
WIN!
……Windy-chan takes first place!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna wiiiiiiin!

With ferocity that could trample anything
in her way,
she tore through the muddy track――
Shinko Windy seized victory.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah, haah, haah……!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Aw, that was so close…… but man,
that girl in first was unreal! Shinko Windy,
right? That raw intensity was insane!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Totally,
she ran like a wild beast out there.
Wonder when her Debut is?
Can't wait to watch her!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: ……Hehe, hehehe! Hehehehehehehehe!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
How'd ya like that?! Ya get it now?!
Windy-chan is incredible! ……Shi-shi-shi!

As Shinko Windy's race concluded…… my own
heart was hammering with adrenaline.

A ferocious drive that could bowl over any
obstacle, and above all,
the raw grit to fight forward and snatch
victory.

Originally,
I just wanted her to regain confidence
through winning and remember the fun of
running. But now――
choice_data_list: But there was one thing I had missed……

text_block_list.text:
I already knew she had talent.
But it went beyond that.
I was certain her potential from here on
out was limitless……!

By the time I reached the dirt track,
she was already swarmed by a crowd of
prospective trainers.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Scouting me?
Wait, you too? For Windy-chan?!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Mmm-hmm! You guys definitely got good eyes!
……Buuuut!
Windy-chan's already picked out her next
prey――

I desperately waved my hands to catch Shinko
Windy's attention,
eager to form a contract with her.
